- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Signs of root rot in succulents include: soft and mushy roots, brown or black roots, leaves turning yellow or brown, shriveling or wilting, black spots on leaves, and a foul smell coming from the soil.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To prevent root rot in succulents, it is important to: use well-draining soil, water only when the soil is completely dry, avoid over-watering (especially in winter), ensure the pot has drainage holes, use a potting mix designed for succulents, not allow water to sit in the saucer or tray, and monitor the health of succulents regularly.
